NEXUS | AZEROTH COMPANION v7.9.5 — Connected Character Research

Move between Character Intelligence and Mythic+, Raid or Reputation research using one public character selector. Share read-only character research links and manually load official Blizzard data.

Expanded PC/mobile tutorials, player testing checklist and release documentation.

Official launch pending real-player acceptance tests.
